    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_PaymentFailedNotice" sourceRef="Task_NotifyPaymentFailed" targetRef="Participant_Customer"/>

    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ShippingConfirmation" sourceRef="Task_SendShippingConfirmation" targetRef="Participant_Customer"/>

    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_RecordOrder" name="Record order details"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_ProcessPayment" name="Process payment"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_PaymentSplit" name="Payment successful?" default="Flow_PaymentSuccess"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_NotifyPaymentFailed" name="Notify customer of payment failure"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_PaymentFailed" name="Process ended: payment failed"/>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_StockSplit" name="Items out of stock?" default="Flow_InStock"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_InitiateBackOrder" name="Initiate back-order"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_NotifyDelay" name="Inform customer of delay"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_BackOrderReceived" name="Back-order received"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_StockMerge" name="Items available in stock"/>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_QualityControl" name="Perform quality control"/>

    <bpmn:manualTask id="Task_GiftWrap" name="Gift wrap items"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_GiftMerge" name="Gift wrapping handled"/>
    <bpmn:manualTask id="Task_Package" name="Package items"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_PrepareShippingDocs" name="Prepare shipping documents and labels"/>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_IntlMerge" name="Customs handling done"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ReadyJoin" name="Packaging and shipping documents ready"/>
    <bpmn:manualTask id="Task_Dispatch" name="Dispatch order"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendShippingConfirmation" name="Send shipping confirmation"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_UpdateInventory" name="Update inventory levels"/>
    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="Gateway_DeliveryEvent" name="Delivery outcome"/>

      <bpmn:manualTask id="Task_ReceiveReturnedItems" name="Receive returned items"/>
      <bpmn:userTask id="Task_InspectReturnedItems" name="Inspect returned items"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_RefundOrReplace" name="Process refund or replacement"/>
      <bpmn:endEvent id="SubEnd_Returns" name="Return process completed"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="FlowReturn_1" sourceRef="SubStart_Returns" targetRef="Task_SendReturnLabel"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="FlowReturn_2" sourceRef="Task_SendReturnLabel" targetRef="Task_ReceiveReturnedItems"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="FlowReturn_3" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveReturnedItems" targetRef="Task_InspectReturnedItems"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="FlowReturn_4" sourceRef="Task_InspectReturnedItems" targetRef="Task_RefundOrReplace"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="FlowReturn_5" sourceRef="Task_RefundOrReplace" targetRef="SubEnd_Returns"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_01" sourceRef="StartEvent_OrderPlaced" targetRef="Task_RecordOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_02" sourceRef="Task_RecordOrder" targetRef="Task_ProcessPayment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_03" sourceRef="Task_ProcessPayment" targetRef="Gateway_PaymentSplit"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_06" sourceRef="Task_NotifyPaymentFailed" targetRef="End_PaymentFailed"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_07" sourceRef="Task_CheckStock" targetRef="Gateway_StockSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OutOfStock" sourceRef="Gateway_StockSplit" targetRef="Task_InitiateBackOrder">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${outOfStock == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InStock" sourceRef="Gateway_StockSplit" targetRef="Gateway_StockMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="Task_InitiateBackOrder" targetRef="Task_NotifyDelay"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="Task_NotifyDelay" targetRef="Event_BackOrderReceived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" sourceRef="Event_BackOrderReceived" targetRef="Gateway_StockMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" sourceRef="Gateway_StockMerge" targetRef="Task_PickItems"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_14" sourceRef="Task_PickItems" targetRef="Task_QualityControl"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_15" sourceRef="Task_QualityControl" targetRef="Gateway_PrepSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_16" sourceRef="Gateway_PrepSplit" targetRef="Gateway_GiftSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_17" sourceRef="Gateway_PrepSplit" targetRef="Task_PrepareShippingDocs"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_GiftWrap" sourceRef="Gateway_GiftSplit" targetRef="Task_GiftWrap">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${giftWrapRequested == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoGiftWrap" sourceRef="Gateway_GiftSplit" targetRef="Gateway_GiftMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_20" sourceRef="Task_GiftWrap" targetRef="Gateway_GiftMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_21" sourceRef="Gateway_GiftMerge" targetRef="Task_Package"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_22" sourceRef="Task_Package" targetRef="Gateway_ReadyJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_23" sourceRef="Task_PrepareShippingDocs" targetRef="Gateway_IntlSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_International" sourceRef="Gateway_IntlSplit" targetRef="Task_CustomsDocs">

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Domestic" sourceRef="Gateway_IntlSplit" targetRef="Gateway_IntlMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_26" sourceRef="Task_CustomsDocs" targetRef="Gateway_IntlMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_27" sourceRef="Gateway_IntlMerge" targetRef="Gateway_ReadyJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_28" sourceRef="Gateway_ReadyJoin" targetRef="Task_Dispatch"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_29" sourceRef="Task_Dispatch" targetRef="Task_SendShippingConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_30" sourceRef="Task_SendShippingConfirmation" targetRef="Task_UpdateInventory"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_31" sourceRef="Task_UpdateInventory" targetRef="Gateway_DeliveryEvent"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_32" sourceRef="Gateway_DeliveryEvent" targetRef="Event_DeliveryConfirmed"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_33" sourceRef="Gateway_DeliveryEvent" targetRef="Event_IssueReported"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_34" sourceRef="Event_DeliveryConfirmed" targetRef="Task_SendFeedbackRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_35" sourceRef="Task_SendFeedbackRequest" targetRef="End_FeedbackSent"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_36" sourceRef="Event_IssueReported" targetRef="SubProcess_Returns"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_37" sourceRef="SubProcess_Returns" targetRef="End_ReturnsDone"/>
  </bpmn:process>
